item.title: Obituary - Jack Wayne Kuhn
item.description: Jack Wayne Kuhn, beloved husband, father, grandfather, brother, nephew, and friend, passed away peacefully on December 10, 2025, in Harrisonville, Missouri.Born on July 28, 1939, in Charleroi, Pennsylvania, Jack was a four-year all-state musician at Rostraver High School. After graduation, he joined the U.S. Air Force and was stationed in Kansas City, Missouri, and San Francisco, California.While in Kansas City, he met and married his love, Anita McKinley. item.title: Obituary - Shirley Marie White
item.description: Shirley Marie White age 87 of Smithville, Missouri departed this life Thursday, December 11, 2025 at Ignite Medical Resort Kansas City, Kansas City, Missouri. Graveside service will be held 2:00 p.m. Wednesday, December 17, 2025 at Garden City Cemetery, Garden City, Missouri. A complete obituary will be posted once that information becomes available, courtesy Dickey Funeral Home.

item.title: Obituary - Carolyn Marie Barry
item.description: Carolyn Marie Barry was born November 7, 1946 in South Carolina, the daughter of Clarage and Jessie Olean (Corder ) Duncan. She departed this life December 13, 2025 in Bolivar, Missouri after a short battle with health issues. Carolyn had made her home in Montrose, Missouri near her daughter Gina. Carolyn's wishes were to be cremated and there is no service of remembrance planned at this time. Courtesy Hill & Son Funeral Home.

item.title: Obituary - Gerald LeRoy "Jerry" Shaw
item.description: Gerald LeRoy "Jerry" Shaw, age 83, formerly of Roeland Park, Kansas passed away Wednesday, December 10, 2025. item.description: Roseann Colvin, 87, Nevada, MO passed away on Wednesday, December 10, 2025 at Medicalodges of Nevada. Roseann was raised near Walker and attended Nevada schools. She was baptized at the Walker Christian Church. item.title: Obituary - Gary Stone
item.description: Gary Ray Stone, born on March 27, 1956, in Bonham, Texas, joined his heavenly family on November 26, 2025, in Louisburg, Kansas.
